prose: Dots are OpenAI's new always-on agents, announced at DevDay 2026 and powered by GPT-6 Astra. Unlike single-turn chat, a Dot keeps working: it crawls the web, pulls context from connected apps, learns preferences, and messages the user through ChatGPT, Slack, or Microsoft Teams. The canned demos: a Dot notices the user's calendar runs through dinner and proactively messages two Grubhub options with prices; another collaborates on launching a website. The agents are personalized as cute nameable blobs and take multi-step projects.
